The repository-at-88 option, chosen against by the person, carries the cost I observed in round 3 on a clone of 7040c29: 70 of 79 files reformatted, +2619/-756, and four modules over 1000 lines, so `ci_check.py --only module-size` exits 1. map.evidence: The one delta scenario, `distribution / Any consumer ruff configuration`, maps to `tests/publisher/test_init_config.py::test_seeded_format_keeps_the_check[no-config]` and `[line-length-60]`. I reproduced it: the unmodified template exits 1 at 88; with the comment as line 2 it exits 0 at line-length 60, 88, 100 and 120, at `--target-version py39`, and with single quotes plus tab indent; `ruff check` with the complexity rules plus RUF028 passes; the seeded pre-commit hook passes. D2's test repeats this observation on every head.
